task_text: IKEA MuJoCo EKET cabinet (IKEA EKET cabinet (AA-1914763-5), manual steps 1-4) with two 7-DoF Franka Panda arms, each with the MuJoCo Menagerie Panda hand (two-finger, tendon-coupled). Build the EKET cabinet frame: slide the two side panels into the top panel, then the back panel into its grooves, then the bottom panel onto the sides, and leave the cabinet standing on the table on its own. Success requirements: The seven operations happen in this order, each measured against the top panel: side A entry and slide, side B entry and slide, back slide, bottom entry and slide. Each one must reach its goal pose within the scene's gates (goal error 0.25 to 0.8 mm, angle 0.1 to 1 degree, nearly at rest, with contact with its counterpart panels). The four frame joints (side A and side B to the top, the bottom to both sides) are latched, and the five panels are finite. At the end the panels are released (no robot contact, no applied force), rest on the table (at least one panel touches the table top, none touches the floor) and move slower than 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s. At the end every panel, the back included (it has no frame joint), is still in its assembled place: within 10 mm and 2 degrees of its goal pose relative to the top panel (the benchmark's end-pose rule, rcb_ikea.END_POSE_RULES). The benchmark's terminal rules, the same in every IKEA MuJoCo task, come on top of these requirements. When your rows end: (1) the requirements above hold; (2) the parts are released: no robot link touches any part; (3) every part is at rest: at most 0.01 m/s and 0.05 rad/s; (4) the simulation never broke down: no non-finite state, no MuJoCo BADQACC / BADQPOS / BADQVEL warning, no contact of a part deeper than 10 mm, at any time. The grader then holds your last row for 1.0 s more and requires (1)-(4) again at its end. Mechanism: Mitres, keyholes, dowels and back grooves are contact. The four frame joints (welds) latch with the measured relative pose when the side A slide, the side B slide and the bottom slide pass their gates.
